reason: I'm two waiters short and the ones I have are already stretched; this is not the month to change how guests pay and how tips come in. I know my regulars by name, I don't need an app to tell me who comes back, and loyalty points feel like a chain thing.
objection: My waiters will push back hard if guests pay on their phones and skip the moment at the table where the tip happens, and I can't afford to lose anyone else right now. Plus there's another fee on every card payment on top of the 59.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it running in a restaurant like mine where the waiters say their tips went up or stayed the same, and someone who sets it up for me without taking my manager's time.
